summary.finding: Six submitted identities have two independent contemporary publisher lineages that establish macOS, the exact version, publicBeta channel, displayed public ordinal, and America/Los_Angeles appearance date. macOS 15.3 Public Beta 3 still has only one complete exact lineage. macOS 15.5 Public Beta 3 remains blocked by an April 28 versus April 29 date conflict and Public Beta 3 versus Public Beta 4 labeling.

reasonCodeDefinitions.APPROVE_TWO_EXACT_INDEPENDENT_LINEAGES: Two independent publisher lineages each establish the full submitted public-beta identity.
reasonCodeDefinitions.APPROVE_WITH_CONFLICT_QUALIFICATION: Two exact independent lineages establish the submitted identity, while a conflicting unselected source remains mandatory context.
reasonCodeDefinitions.APPROVE_WITH_SOURCE_TYPO_QUALIFICATION: Two independent lineages establish the submitted identity, but one selected page contains obvious copied-version typos outside the narrowly selected contextual proof.
reasonCodeDefinitions.BLOCK_SECOND_EXACT_LINEAGE_MISSING: Only one publisher lineage establishes every required identity field.
reasonCodeDefinitions.BLOCK_DATE_AND_ORDINAL_CONFLICT: No two independent lineages agree on the submitted public ordinal and Pacific date.
